title: The plugin's review step starts a read-only reviewer, not a worker brief (second-project run)
goal: The review step of the plugin's sprint skill starts its fresh-context reviewer with a reviewer brief (read-only, report gaps) and no work branch, instead of dispatching the review story as a worker
notes: Run finding 26: dispatch ST-... (review story) made a worker worktree on work/ST-... with the worker's brief and write access; it found no gap and committed nothing.
